deloitte-2025-pdf/c01.evidence:
8.4 On 1 July 2018, the Targeted Compliance Framework (TCF) commenced,
replacing the previous compliance framework.2 The TCF is the mechanism for
enforcing mutual obligation requirements:
The TCF is comprised of three zones: Green Zone, the Warning Zone and
the Penalty Zone. All job seekers will start in the Green Zone and, so long
as they meet all their Mutual Obligation Requirements, they will remain in
this zone. Where a job seeker commits a Mutual Obligation Failure they
will move to the Warning Zone. If they continue to be non-compliant, they
will be in either the Warning Zone or the Penalty Zone.3
